_source: Verbatim Thai i18n PHRASEs consumed by LandPipeline (pototype/land.jsx LandPipeline L62-132 + openPlotDetail L279-317), kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so no Thai literal sits in land-pipeline.tsx — same pattern as land-bank-strings.json / boq-strings.json. Every visible string in LandPipeline is an existing DICT key used via t() (land.pipeline.* / land.stage.* / land.tenure.* / land.unit.* / land.bc.root / land.action.export / land.field.deed / land.detail.* / land.bank.colGps / land.bank.filterTenureHint / land.common.project); the TWO exceptions are the KPI-3 unit 'ล้านบาท' and the baht sign '฿' on the detail price rows, neither of which the land.* dict covers — both reuse EXISTING phrases keys (tp), exactly like land-bank-strings.json unitMillionBaht. CONSUME-ONLY, nothing minted here. Confirmed present in i18n-full.json phrases: ล้านบาท (L19914), ฿.
